issues.explanation: The new mention behavior ships with no Pest/PHPUnit test at all, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaving the digit bounds, invalid-config rejection and mention-preserving 1800-character truncation unverified.

review.summary: The change adds the DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting and appends a validated <@id> mention on its own line while reserving room so the alert stays within 1800 characters, with docs, .env.example and CHANGELOG updated. The implementation itself looks correct and in scope, but it ships with zero tests, which the project's conventions make a merge blocker.
